title: Story/Lore Overview
subtitle: A lore-pack foundation with Terminal, Index, MissionCore, SignalOS, Lens, HoloMap, tutorials, and SoundCore.
summary: A creator-ready story foundation with chapters, archives, missions, scan objectives, map markers, and Terminal presentation examples.
body:
Open an archive chapter, follow a mission chain, scan a clue, track the objective, and play a subtle notification.

First 30 minutes:
- Open the Chapter 1 archive entry.
- Accept the starter mission chain.
- Track the first objective marker.
- Scan a story clue with Lens.

First 2 hours:
- Add two more chapter records and connect them to missions.
- Use SoundCore for subtle progression notifications.
- Build a Terminal dashboard that reflects the creator's own story world.
